data.content:
apiVersion: openslo/v1
kind: SLO
metadata:
  annotations:
    datafocal/group-by: endpoint
  name: gateway-prometheus
spec:
  alertPolicies:
  - kind: AlertPolicy
    metadata:
      name: burn
    spec:
      conditions:
      - kind: AlertCondition
        metadata:
          annotations:
            datafocal/short-window: 5m
          name: fast
        spec:
          condition:
            kind: burnrate
            lookbackWindow: 1h
            op: gte
            threshold: 14.4
          severity: page
  budgetingMethod: Occurrences
  indicator:
    spec:
      ratioMetric:
        good:
          metricSource:
            spec:
              query: '{service="gateway"} | status < 500'
            type: Prometheus
        total:
          metricSource:
            spec:
              query: '{service="gateway"}'
            type: Prometheus
  objectives:
  - target: 0.99
  service: gateway
  timeWindow:
  - duration: 1d
    isRolling: true
---
apiVersion: datafocal/v1
kind: View
metadata:
  displayName: Gateway
  name: gateway
spec:
  panels:
  - grid:
      h: 4
      w: 8
      x: 0
      "y": 0
    kind: timeseries
    query: sum by (status) (count_over_time({service="gateway", endpoint="$endpoint"}
      [1m]))
  - grid:
      h: 4
      w: 4
      x: 8
      "y": 0
    kind: slo
    slo: gateway
  time:
    from: now-1h
    to: now
  variables:
  - allowAll: true
    column: endpoint
    name: endpoint
